title: Always Planning Trips? You Could Win a Swiss Holiday
paragraphs: You book the flights. You find the hotel. You make a plan for each day of the trip. But when you're finally enjoying those plans with your friends, you might be disappointed not to hear a "thank you."
In fact, a recent survey by travel company Klook found that many people who plan trips feel that they're rarely thanked for doing so.
And 80% of participants said all that planning can take up to 10 hours for just one trip!
So Klook has found a way to thank five lucky planners for all their hard work.
The company has announced a new competition in which participants can win a trip to Switzerland.
The prize covers all expenses for a seven-day trip, including flights, accommodation and activities.
Marcus Yong, Vice President of Global Marketing at Klook, said that the competition is a chance for trip planners to "take a vacation from planning vacations."
To enter the competition, you must be at least 21 years old, have a valid passport and be available to travel to Switzerland for seven days this December.
You must then fill in an online form and share experiences you've had planning trips.
Klook also wants you to speak about a time "your friend group chat drove you crazy" — something many planners probably have experience with!
And if you're not a planner, but you know someone who is, you can also fill in an application nominating that person!
Applications are open until the end of August, and Klook will choose five winners from around the world.
Each winner can also bring a friend with them — and hopefully that friend will remember to say "thank you!"
